title: An oxbow lake is a river bend that got left behind
body: As a river erodes the outside of a bend, the neck between its two sides can grow narrow. When the river cuts through the neck, sediment can seal off the old loop and leave a curved lake.
takeaway: A lake beside a river can mark exactly where the river once ran.
source: US Geological Survey, Earthshots: Oxbow Lakes
visual: a crescent lake beside a straighter river channel seen from above

title: The Philippines' Tubbataha reef has a 100-metre wall
body: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park in the Philippines includes two atolls, shallow lagoons and coral islands. One of its prominent features is a reef wall that drops nearly vertically for about 100 metres.
takeaway: A reef can change from a shallow platform to deep water in a very short horizontal distance.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park
visual: a steep coral reef wall dropping into an expanse of dark sea
